items.statement: Every actual squared truncated summand is integrable, and the sum of its expectations has the exact source PSD upper bound.

formulae.label: Actual Gaussian truncated matrix second moments
formulae.tex: Y_i^2\in L^1(\mu)\quad(1\le i\le d),\qquad\sum_{i=1}^d\mathbb E_\mu[Y_i^2]\preceq\frac{2r(r+2)}d I_{r^2}.

assumptions: Let \(d,q\in\mathbb N\) satisfy \(2q+1<d\), and put \(r=q+1\). The case \(q=0\) is included. All denominator positivity follows internally.

Use exactly \(\Omega=(\mathbb R^d)^r\), \(\mu=\gamma_d^{\otimes r}\), and the actual physical row \(\Phi_i(\omega)=(\omega_{1,i},\ldots,\omega_{r,i})\), with \(\gamma_j=N(0,I_j)\). No replacement row experiment or caller law certificate is used.

Put \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(t_i=(1,\sqrt2\cos\theta_i,\ldots,\sqrt2\cos(q\theta_i))\), \(R_i=\|\Phi_i\|^2\) and \(L=2r+3\log(1000d)\). Source physical index \(i\) corresponds to \(i.val+1\).

The literal matrix is \(Y_i=d^{-1}(\Phi_i\Phi_i^\top\otimes t_it_i^\top)\mathbf1_{\{R_i\le L\}}\), with the Gaussian coordinate first in each paired Kronecker index. Each row keeps its own inclusive cutoff, under the same unconditional original law.

Squares use ordinary matrix multiplication, and expectations are actual Bochner integrals in the Euclidean operator norm. Every squared summand is proved integrable. Full Hermitian/quadratic PSD is used throughout.

The only source proposition input is \(2q+1<d\). Row law, fourth moment, frame, integrability, and the uncentered squared-moment PSD estimate are proved internally. Joint independence, exact first-mean/a identities, \(\tau\), \(\kappa\), and Bernstein assumptions are not inputs.

obligations.label: Every actual squared truncated summand is integrable, and the sum of its expectations has the exact source PSD upper bound.

bindings.boundary: The public declaration proves the actual uncentered squared-moment comparison. The separate private Tests consumer proves centered and cosine-weighted square integrability and both true operator-norm comparisons in the same original experiment. Only the uncentered declaration is a public API; the centered and weighted theorem is a private implementation consumer. Verification and publication evidence is recorded separately in the existing Frontier Cell and semantic audit. Public API canonicalization, matrix concentration, main lower bounds, exact oracle/precision/TV/query-cap/cost adapters and serialized integration/purification are distinct later obligations.
